stem: Duchenne muscular dystrophy follows which inheritance pattern?
explanation: X-linked recessive inheritance is the correct pattern for Duchenne muscular dystrophy. It typically affects males and is carried by females on the X chromosome.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because Duchenne muscular dystrophy is not inherited as a dominant autosomal condition.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because although some neuromuscular disorders are autosomal recessive, Duchenne muscular dystrophy is linked to the X chromosome.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because Duchenne muscular dystrophy is caused by an X-linked recessive mutation, so males are typically affected and females are usually carriers.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because mitochondrial inheritance is passed through the maternal line to all children and does not fit Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because Y-linked disorders would affect only males through the Y chromosome, which is not the inheritance pattern for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

source.hint: Consider the chromosome involved and why males are the ones who typically exhibit symptoms.
